title: Total query probability equals input cost
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $Omega$ and $alpha$ be types, let $f:Omega^n\toalpha$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree computing $f$, with a finite nonempty seed space and a probability law on its seeds. For every input $x\inOmega^n$, the sum over all coordinates of the probability that $T$ queries that coordinate on $x$ equals the expected number of queries made on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a randomized decision tree with a finite nonempty seed space and seed probability law
